### God’s Protective Care
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-march-26-2022.html
Passage: Psalm 91:1-2
Points:
- God does not remove believers from an evil world but offers spiritual insulation within it.
- Dwelling requires an ongoing consciousness of God's presence and daily dependence on Him.
- Divine shelter operates like a secret hideaway where beleaguered believers find rest.
- God does not merely grant defense; He Himself is the believer's fortress and refuge.
- Total trust in God resembles a high-rise worker relying completely on a safety harness.

### Sheltered in His Wings
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-august-17-2026.html
Passage: Psalm 91:4-5
Points:
- God shields His people tenderly, much like a mother bird sheltering her young.
- Courage comes not from human strength, but from knowing God is continually present.
- Spiritual arrows of fear, malice, and impure thoughts constantly target believers.
- God's faithful truth serves as a dependable armor against enemy assaults.
- Scripture does not promise an absence of trouble, but assures God's protection through it.

### When Trouble Comes
Author: Katie Westenberg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/when-trouble-comes-bible-study-minute-january-15-2018.html
Passage: Psalm 91:4
Points:
- The image of divine wings combines fierce protection with gentle, attentive care.
- Seeking refuge assumes that real dangers, diseases, and terrors actively exist.
- God never guarantees a hardship-free life, but promises His presence in the trial.
- Making the Lord our dwelling place anchors hope in Him rather than in circumstances.
- Believers can reject fear because God provides security and deliverance in every trouble.

### Giving Thanks for the Hidden Refuge
Author: Sarah Frazer
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/giving-thanks-for-the-hidden-refuge-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 91:1
Points:
- Believers can thank God beforehand for His promised future protection.
- God's refuge is an unseen spiritual reality that constantly surrounds Christians.
- Life contains real perils at all times, but God's authority overcomes every evil.
- Holding fast to God in love leads to deeper awareness of His trustworthy character.
- Calling out to God invites His peace and reassurance during times of trouble.
